components.summary: Chooses the layer the block occupies. The layer decides how the block is drawn and whether it is solid.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: A block with kurblanc:wall defaults to wall. Everything else defaults to floor.

components.behavior: An unknown value fails when the world content is registered. Objects must set "object" explicitly.

components.summary: Fallback colour for previews, break particles and light when no light colour is given.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Six hex digits. Shorthand and named colours are rejected.

components.behavior: A value that is not #rrggbb fails when the world content is registered.

components.summary: Display name for the block and for an item that places it.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Optional.

components.behavior: A non-string value is stored as-is; keep it a string.

components.summary: Chooses the sound set used for placing, breaking and stepping on the block.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: The active asset pack must provide the set.

components.behavior: Anything other than a lower_snake_case name fails while the block is parsed.

components.summary: Allows or forbids placing this block from an item.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Set false on the open state of a door or gate.

components.behavior: A non-boolean value fails when the world content is registered.

components.summary: Makes a raised block solid or walk-through.

fields.name: value
fields.default: true on wall and object layers; false on floor
fields.notes: Floor blocks cannot be solid.

components.behavior: A non-boolean value fails when the world content is registered; a solid floor is rejected.

components.summary: Gives a raised block a smaller collision box than its tile.

fields.name: box
fields.range: origin -32 to 64, positive size, box inside 64×64
fields.notes: Tile-local pixels.

fields.name: verticalBox
fields.notes: Used when the block is seen as a vertical face.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Keeps neighbouring footprints aligned.

fields.name: verticalMasks
fields.notes: Cardinal masks that use verticalBox.

components.behavior: Out-of-bounds rectangles, a floor block or a bad mask fails when the world content is registered.

components.summary: Draws an object-facing sprite so it turns with the camera.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Only meaningful on the object layer.

components.behavior: A non-boolean value fails when the world content is registered.

components.summary: How much light the block absorbs.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: 0 is fully transparent; 15 stops light.

components.behavior: A value outside 0–15 or a non-integer fails when the world content is registered.

components.summary: Sets mining time and the tools that speed it up or are required.

fields.name: seconds_to_destroy
fields.notes: Converted to game ticks.

fields.name: preferred_tool
fields.notes: A matching tool mines at its own speed.

fields.name: required_tool
fields.notes: The block cannot be harvested without that tool kind and tier.

components.behavior: A bad mining field fails while the block is parsed. false is accepted and leaves the default mining time.

components.summary: Points at a loot table instead of an inline drop list.

fields.name: table
fields.notes: Cannot be combined with kurblanc:drops.

components.behavior: A missing table or a definition that also has kurblanc:drops fails.

components.summary: Lists the items a successful break can produce.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Each entry rolls independently. Omit chance for a guaranteed drop.

components.behavior: A non-array, an unknown item or a chance outside 0–1 fails.

components.summary: Makes the block a light source.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: 0 or less is ignored and leaves the block unlit.

components.behavior: A value above 15 fails when the world content is registered.

components.summary: Tints the light the block emits.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Only used together with kurblanc:light_emission.

components.behavior: A value that is not #rrggbb fails when the world content is registered.

components.summary: Binds the block faces to texture keys from the active asset packs.

fields.name: * or up.texture
fields.notes: Primary face. The key is defined in AP/textures/terrain_texture.json.

fields.name: * or up.rect
fields.notes: Crops one sprite from a packed sheet.

fields.name: front.texture
fields.notes: Front face of a wall. Separate from the top texture.

components.behavior: A missing primary texture or an unknown key fails while content is resolved.

components.summary: Recolours greyscale art with the colour of the biome the tile stands in.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: The art must be authored neutral grey for the tint to read correctly.

components.behavior: A non-boolean value fails while the block is parsed.

components.summary: Marks a floor block as natural ground with corner tiling and optional rotation.

fields.name: random_rotate
fields.notes: Rotates each tile from a stable hash.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Ground of the same group connects.

fields.name: substrate
fields.notes: The material shown under the surface.

fields.name: tint
fields.notes: Fixed colour multiply for the art.

fields.name: biome_tint
fields.notes: Same as the top-level component when that is absent.

components.behavior: Bad field types fail while the block is parsed or when content is registered.

components.summary: Marks a floor block as a built surface that connects in 47 shapes.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Surfaces of the same group connect.

components.behavior: The texture must use the surface sheet layout; the game does not slice an arbitrary image.

components.summary: Marks a block as a wall and sets how far its top is raised.

fields.name: lift
fields.notes: Top elevation in source pixels.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Walls of the same group connect.

components.behavior: A lift outside 0–32 fails when the world content is registered.

components.summary: Turns a floor block into water with a visible bed underneath.

fields.name: bed
fields.notes: Shown where the water is shallow or exposed.

fields.name: opacity
fields.notes: Water tint strength, not the 0–15 light opacity.

components.behavior: A missing bed or an opacity outside the open range fails while the block is parsed.

components.summary: Describes a raised sprite: crop, offset, depth, shadow and variants.

fields.name: height
fields.notes: Visual height only; collision stays on the tile footprint.

fields.name: rect
fields.notes: Crops the sprite from its sheet.

fields.name: sprite_offset
fields.notes: Moves the sprite relative to the tile.

fields.name: depth
fields.notes: Draw order against floors.

fields.name: vertical_depth
fields.notes: Draw order against walls.

fields.name: vertical_rect
fields.notes: Alternate crop for a vertical face.

fields.name: vertical_offset
fields.notes: Offset for the vertical crop.

fields.name: vertical_masks
fields.notes: Cardinal masks that use the vertical crop.

fields.name: shadow
fields.notes: Projects the sprite alpha instead of a box.

fields.name: contact_shadow
fields.notes: Root-contact ellipse.

fields.name: group
fields.notes: Keeps neighbouring sprites sorted together.

fields.name: random_flip
fields.notes: Mirrors from a stable tile hash.

fields.name: sway
fields.notes: Adds ambient movement to foliage.

fields.name: variant_weights
fields.range: one positive weight per strip frame
fields.notes: The strip's cell is declared on the texture key.

fields.name: foliage
fields.notes: canopyEnd is greater than 0 and less than 1; leafTextures holds 1–32 keys.

fields.name: tint
fields.notes: Fixed colour multiply for the sprite.

fields.name: biome_tint
fields.notes: Same as the top-level component when that is absent.

fields.name: biome_tint_scale
fields.notes: Darkens a biome-tinted sprite.

components.behavior: Bad rectangle sizes, masks, shadow values or tint colours fail while the block is parsed.

components.summary: Makes a floor block take part in buildable terrain fill or cover.

fields.name: mode
fields.notes: fill forms the ground mass; cover is applied on top.

fields.name: face
fields.notes: Only allowed on fill, for the exposed edge.

components.behavior: Terrain on anything but a floor, or face on cover, fails when content is registered.

components.summary: Lets one object sit on another, such as a ladder attached to a wall.

fields.name: down
fields.notes: How many levels down the support may be.

components.behavior: A non-object link, an extra field or a level outside 1–16 fails.

components.summary: Groups two matching door leaves so they open together.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Both leaves and both open states use the same value.

components.behavior: A pair without a matching object toggle state fails when content is registered.

components.summary: Names the block a door or gate becomes when used.

fields.name: value
fields.range: a block ID on the same layer
fields.notes: Use it on both states, pointing at each other.

components.behavior: A missing target, air, or a block on another layer fails when content is registered.
